overview:

days.title: Sightseeing at Mykonos
prose: Breakfast is served at the hotel

All days free at your leisure. Among the cobbled streets, next to the churches, behind the freshly painted shutters, through the delivery of island living, the heavenly beaches and the liveliness of the night, Mykonos still keeps its secrets:
The happiest different moments for everyone, here, on the most famous island in the world, each one of us makes each moment UNIQUE
Mykonos retains full beauty through the passage of time, and is and always will be a perfect host to visitors

days.title: Santorini Volcano Tour
prose: Breakfast is served at the hotel
At the designated time - Pick up from your hotel or nearby meeting point and drive to Tour terminal to start a full-day boat tour to Volcano, Hot Springs, Thirassia Island and Cruise below Oia
The tour starts by bus from the pick-up point which brings us to the port where you will board the traditional boat
Starting the tour the boat will sail to the Volcanic Island of Nea Kameni, where you will stop and have the opportunity to walk up the dirt path and approach the cone of the still active Volcano
After experiencing, the cone, walk back down the dirt path to the boat, which will bring you to the second lava island Palea Kameni, where you find the hot springs
The boat will anchor 50 meters from the opening where you can swim in the green Sulphur waters of the hot springs, wet your feet or just enjoy the view
The tour continues after the hot springs to Thirassia Island which was once part of Santorini before the big Explosion of the Volcano

There you will stay for two hours and you will have the opportunity to do some activities like swimming on the beach of Thirassia, have lunch next to the Sea or just explore the Village of Manolas with its winding steps and traditional houses

Later your boat brings you then to the port of Oia underneath Oia Village where you will walk up the steps to reach Village in order to enjoy one of the most amazing sunsets in the world. The tour ends 30 minutes after the sunset when you will gather at the pickup point in Oia where the bus will be waiting to bring you back to the point where you started from
Kindly note that there is a 2.50 € EURO entrance fee per person to the volcano, by local Authorities collected on the spot
For the volcano, wear comfortable shoes and take sun protection with you. The Volcano Cone ascent and descent are approx. 1 hour
All your personal belongings must be taken from the bus and from the boat
The tour boats are offering snacks and beverages onboard (not included in the rate) and occasionally free Wi fi on board

You might like to take the island’s traditional donkey ride at Fira Town
